title: Request an OEM quote
intro: Looking for roasted coffee beans or coffee capsules for your own brand? Tell us how much coffee you need, the flavours you like and how you’d like it packed.
type: What would you like us to make?
system_hint: If you know the brand and model of your machine, enter them here. You can leave this blank if you’re still choosing.
flavour_hint: For example, rich chocolate notes for milk drinks or a bright, fruity black coffee.
packaging_hint: Would you like labels on your bags or your logo printed on the box? Let us know if you already have artwork.
destination_hint: The city or province and country are enough.
budget_hint: Include the currency. If you have a target unit price, say whether it’s per bag, per box or per capsule.
contact_help: Leave an email address or phone number so the roastery can reply.
name: Contact name
required_help: Fields marked * are required. We also need an email address or phone number.
privacy: We’ll use these details to prepare your quotation and contact you about this project.
review_online: Check the quantities, packaging and contact details, then send your request to the roastery.
manual: To send your request, message the roastery with a copy of the summary or attach the downloaded file.
success: Keep your request reference. We’ll use the email address or phone number you provided to discuss your quotation.
failed: We couldn’t confirm delivery. Try again with the same request reference, or message the summary to the roastery.
copy_hint: The summary is selected. Use Copy on your device.
talk_body: If you’re unsure how much to order or which capsule system to use, get in touch and we’ll talk it through.
how: How we work out your quote
how_body: We use the coffee you choose, your order size and your packaging requirements to work out a price. We’ll confirm delivery details with you.
noscript: Call or message the roastery with the products and quantities you have in mind.
select_type: Choose the products you want a quote for.
invalid_contact: Enter an email address or phone number so we can reply.
invalid_name: Enter the name of the person we should contact.
invalid_phone: Enter a valid phone number. Include the country code for numbers outside Thailand.
invalid_date: Choose today or a later delivery date.
email_attach: Your full request won’t fit in the email draft. Download the quote request and attach the file before sending.
email_body: I’ve attached my quote request for coffee under my own brand.
manual_email: Open the email draft and send it to the roastery, or copy the summary into a message.
too_large: Your request is too long to send. Shorten the notes and try again, or download the request and email it to the roastery.
invalid_request: Check your details and try again. You can also download your quote request and email it to the roastery.
ref_conflict: That reference is already in use. Check the new request reference above and send your request again.
rate_limit: Too many requests have come through at once. Try again later with the same reference, or email the roastery.
